Five mechanisms, all fix-candidate: (A, 37) CommandCreateElementMultilines never ported into the class engine; (B, 4) REL_ARROW's crow's-foot alternative lacks a dotted body / CIRCLE '0' token / mid-arrow style bracket; (C, 1) CLASS_ID hardcodes '.' regardless of a configured namespaceSeparator; (D, 1) the note-declaration CODE regex excludes dots upstream allows; (E, 3) sequence's CommandArrow over-claims a bare-dressing arrow and an unrestricted style-token vocabulary that upstream refuses, so sequence (registered before class) wins a block class would otherwise correctly claim. See diagnosis/T4.md for the full table and per-mechanism citations.

CommandArrow.java:311-313: when neither ARROW_DRESSING1 nor ARROW_DRESSING2 carries any of <,\\,/,>,x,o (a bare '--'-only body, no arrowhead/cross/circle at all), executeArg returns CommandExecutionResult.error('Illegal sequence arrow') -- upstream's sequence engine refuses a plain association dash with zero decoration. Separately, CommandArrow.java:482-502 applyStyle only recognizes 'dashed'/'bold'/'dotted'/'hidden' as non-color style tokens; any OTHER LINE_STYLE token the shared regex accepts syntactically (e.g. 'thickness=5', which is valid class-relationship style per CommandLinkElement.java:71 but not a sequence arrow style) falls to `HColorSet.instance().getColor(s)`, throws NoSuchColorException, and that uncaught Throwable is caught by PSystemBuilder.java:271's per-factory catch, which discards the sequence result and tries the next factory (class) -- bisected against the real jar: 'a --> b' -> SEQUENCE, 'a -[dashed]-> b' -> SEQUENCE, 'a -[thickness=5]-> b' -> CLASS. This port's command-arrow.ts accepts both a no-dressing bare body (UNDRESSED_ARROW_RE has no equivalent 'Illegal sequence arrow' refusal) and an unrestricted style-token vocabulary (no dashed/bold/dotted/hidden whitelist), so sequence claims what upstream's own sequence factory refuses, and -- tried before class in registration order -- wins the block.
